verdict.rationale: Wrike documents an in-app AI assistant (Wrike Copilot) and AI content and editing, so this axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows that assistant learning a user's tone, shorthand, or preferences to tailor its output. Personalized dashboards and custom AI agents are adjacent features, not assistant personalization, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have my in-app AI assistant learn my tone, shorthand, and preferences to tailor its output
